about.title: About The Khedut
about.subtitle: Empowering Indian Agriculture through Next-Generation Digital Intelligence
about.mission_desc: To bridge the gap between advanced agricultural science and grassroots farmers across India with hyper-local weather, disease diagnosis, APMC mandi intelligence, and expert consultations.
about.vision_desc: Engineered from the soil up with multi-lingual voice assistance in Gujarati, Hindi, and English to serve farmers of all literacy levels.
about.values_desc: Truthful agronomy recommendations, transparent market pricing, zero data exploitation, and dedicated farmer prosperity.

support.title: Help & Support Center
support.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about using The Khedut.
support.faq_1_q: How accurate is the leaf pathology disease diagnosis?
support.faq_1_a: Our AI diagnostic models are trained on over 100,000 field-verified pathology scans with 95%+ laboratory accuracy. For critical cases, you can also connect directly with university agronomists.
support.faq_2_q: Where do the Mandi commodity prices come from?
support.faq_2_a: Daily prices are fetched in real-time from official Agmarknet APMC government databases across Gujarat, Maharashtra, and India.
support.faq_3_q: How do I switch the platform language to Gujarati or Hindi?
support.faq_3_a: Click the globe icon in the top navigation bar or go to Settings > Regional Configuration to choose English, Gujarati, or Hindi.
support.faq_4_q: How do I export official PDF statements?
support.faq_4_a: Navigate to PDF Reports from the sidebar to generate, preview, and download authenticated multi-lingual crop, pathology, and expense statements.
support.contact_support: Need direct assistance? Contact our agritech support team.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms and conditions carefully before using The Khedut.
terms.section_1_desc: By accessing or using The Khedut, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable agricultural advisory guidelines.
terms.section_2_desc: AI recommendations and weather projections are assistive intelligence tools. Farmers are encouraged to inspect physical soil, crop condition, and local university advisory before applying heavy chemical inputs.
terms.section_3_desc: You are responsible for safeguarding your credentials and farm data. We respect your ownership of all crop, field, and financial records.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How The Khedut protects, manages, and respects your agricultural data.
privacy.section_1_desc: We collect only data necessary for delivering agricultural intelligence: location coordinates (for weather and APMC mandis), crop scans, and optional farm ledger notes.
privacy.section_2_desc: Your farm data belongs to you. We do not sell your personal, financial, or yield records to third-party commercial marketing entities.
privacy.section_3_desc: All data in transit and at rest is protected by industry standard encryption protocols.

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.subtitle: Clear, fair refund guidelines for The Khedut subscriptions and paid consultations.
refund.section_1_desc: If you are not satisfied with The Khedut Premium within the first 7 days of activation, you can request a 100% full refund with no questions asked.
refund.section_2_desc: Appointments cancelled at least 2 hours before the scheduled time slot will be refunded in full or rescheduled at no extra charge.
